questions.solution:
Endrew who sits middle of a side, sits to the fourth left of the Garvit. Himesh sits to the immediate left of Charanjit, Charanjit sits to the third right of Endrew.

Only one person sits between Garvit and Farooq.

Bala is an immediate neighbour of Endrew. Bala is not a neighbour of Farooq.

Only three people sit between Bala and Anuj. Hence, we are left with only one place for Danish to sit.

Hence, the person who is sitting 3rd to the right of Danish is Himesh.

Sanjay is second to the left of Anil. Rahul is fourth to the right of Anil.

Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Rahul or Sanjay.

Aakash is second to the right of Ram. Case 1 is eliminated.

Kamal is second to the right of Vivek.

Hence, the person who is third to right of Ramu is Vivek.

U was sitting opposite to P, who was to the immediate left of R.

S was sitting to the immediate right of U, and T was exactly between P and S.

Sitting location of Q is opposite to T, immediate left of U, and immediate right of R.

Hence, option (a) is correct.

Sanjay is third to the right of Ramu. Ramu is second to the right of Anil. Aakash is second to the right of Ramu.

Ram is the immediate neighbour of both Ramu and Anil. Ram is second to the left of Kamal.

Vivek is not the immediate neighbour of Anil. So, there is only place for Sanjay to sit.

Hence, the person sitting second to right of Vivek is Anil.

Kajal is to immediate left of Mansi.

Shweta is third to the left of Mansi.

Payal is second to the right of Kajal.

Monika is not second to the left of Mansi which means Aarti is sitting second to the left of Mansi.

Hence, Monika is second to the right of Mansi.

Six students - Aman, Bobby, Chintu, Gita, Pranay and Ram - are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre.

Ram is sitting second to the right of Gita. Aman is sitting third to the right of Gita.

Pranay is the immediate neighbour of Gita and Bobby.

Now, only Chintu is remaining.

Aman is the immediate neighbour of both Ram and Bobby.

Kajal is second to the left of Laxmi, Payal is the immediate neighbour of both Mansi and Laxmi.

Aarti is second to the left of Kajal.

Monika is not the immediate neighbour of Laxmi. So, we are left with only one position for Shweta to sit.

Hence, the person who is sitting 2nd to the left of Payal is Shweta.

Raj is second to the right of Aman.

Sunil is third to the left of Aman.

Ram is not the immediate neighbour of Aman.

Amit is second to the right of Ram. Case 1 is eliminated here.

Rahul is not the immediate neighbour of Amit.

So, we are left with only one place to sit for Sumit.

Hence, person sitting third to the left of Sumit is Ram.

Vivek is third to the right of Kamal. Kamal is second to the right of Sanjay.

Anil is second to the right of Vivek. Ram is second to the right of Anil.

Rahul is third to the right of Aakash. So, we are left with only position for Ramu to sit.

Hence, the person who is third to the left of Anil is Ramu.

· Seven friends - E, F, G, H, I, J and K, are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre.

· F and I are sitting to the immediate left and right of G, respectively.

· H is sitting third to the left of G.

· E and I are the neighbors of J.

· Remaining K sits immediate right of H.

Mansi is third to the left of Monika.

Aarti is second to the right of Monika.

Payal is second to the left of Mansi.

Shweta is fourth to the left of Payal.

Kajal is not the immediate neighbour of Mansi. Which means Kajal is sitting between Monika and Aarti.

Rani is third to the right of Kajal.

Now, we are left with only one position for Laxmi to sit.

Hence, the person sitting second to the right of Kajal is Payal.

Four friends, H, I, J and K, are sitting at the four corners of a square facing towards the centre. H and J are sitting at diagonally opposite corners.

I is sitting to the immediate left of H. Who is sitting to the immediate right of J?

Thus, the remaining friend, K is sitting immediate to the right of H.

Therefore, the final arrangement is:

Thus, I is sitting to the immediate right of J.

Anu sits to the immediate left of Ankita.

Anveshi sits second to the right of Anu.

Aisha does not sit adjacent to Anveshi and Amy sits exactly between Asha and Aisha.

Hence, Anveshi sits to the immediate right of Ankita.

P is second to the right of Q.

M is the immediate neighbour of both J and Q.

N is second to the right of P.

L is not the immediate neighbour of Q.

So, we are left with only one place to sit for K.

Hence, the person sitting to immediate left of L is P.

• Raghav, Manpreet, Sunaina, Prakrit, Vedika and Arwa are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

• Raghav is second to the left of Prakrit.

• There are an equal number of persons between Raghav and Manpreet from both the ends.

• Manpreet is to the immediate left of Sunaina.

• Arwa is second to the right of Vedika.

"Arwa" is sitting third to the left of Sunaina.

Seven friends, Subhi, Prince, Ketan, Vishal, Mahima, Krish and Naitik, are sitting around a circular table with their backs towards the centre.

Subhi is the immediate right of Prince.

Vishal is sitting third to the left of Prince.

Naitik and Krish are not sitting to the immediate left or right Vishal.

Mahima is sitting to the immediate right of vishal.

Thus, Ketan is sitting third to the right of Prince.

E who sits at the centre of a side, sits to the fourth left of the G.

C sits to the third right of E. H sits to the immediate left of C.

Only one person sits between G and F.

B is immediate neighbour of E.

Only three people sit between B and A. A is not a neighbour of D. (Case 2 eliminated.)

Hence, the person sitting 3rd to the right of D is H.

P, Q, R, S, T and U are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between T and R. Only one person sits between R and U.

Only two people sit between U and Q. S sits to the immediate left of T.

Thus, Case 1 gets cancelled.

Now, only P is remaining.

Q sits second to the left of P.

U is sitting to the immediate left of W.

W and V are sitting next to each other.

X sits exactly in between V and Y.

Hence, the person who is sitting to the immediate left of U is Y.

Vidhi is sitting second to the left of Sriti and is in between Tania and Urusha.

Sriti is not a neighbor to Rani or Tania. So, case 2 is eliminated and also Rani will next to Tania while Priti will sit next to Sriti.

Hence, the person sitting to the immediate right of Priti is Rani.
